entity.description:
The Aldegara Waterfall is a location in Virtual Boy Wario Land. Wario uses his Bulldog to travel here while on a vacation at the Awazon River Basin, and it is where he notices three Mask-Guys carrying treasure behind the Aldegara Waterfall. This occurrence in particular is shown from artwork in the instruction booklet, in which the Bulldog is seen parked on the riverbed just outside the waterfall.
